name: jump_timing
chapter: Core mechanics: when a ground jump leaves the ground, and the run's start (docs/REFERENCE_COMPARISON.md M13 "Jump timing", M94 "Run start from rest")
note: l3_main_bedroom, the corridor of the Wine traces jumpfid/*.txt and screens/stairs/j_*.txt. tru.exe starts a request's clip at (start - blend) frames (0x4428A0 -> 0x441FB0), so ng_standing_jump (6 / 6) takes its whole 10 frames, ng_running_jump_forwards 2, and ng_run_start (4 / 6) moves as from its frame 2; the jump with the stick leaves the ground 8 frames after the press, carried 128 along the stick meanwhile. Under Wine, from the key (which reaches the game up to 35 ms later): 342..359 ms standing, 273..290 ms with the stick, 70..109 ms running. Each take-off step ends on the first airborne tick: its length = the wait before the press + the take-off.
